Package dev.turboism.sdk.appearance

Record Class AppearancePalette

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.turboism.sdk.appearance.AppearancePalette
Record Components:
accent - primary accent color
background - main background color
surface - raised-surface color
inputBackground - editable-control background color
foreground - primary foreground color
mutedForeground - secondary foreground color
selectionBackground - selected-content background color
selectionForeground - selected-content foreground color
border - border and divider color
viewportBackground - canvas or viewport background color
public record AppearancePalette(String accent, String background, String surface, String inputBackground, String foreground, String mutedForeground, String selectionBackground, String selectionForeground, String border, String viewportBackground) extends Record
Bounded semantic colors understood by a supported appearance provider.

Every component is normalized to upper-case #RRGGBB. Values name semantic roles, not concrete Editor controls, and unsupported providers can still report an unavailable result.

      public AppearancePalette(String accent, String background, String surface, String inputBackground, String foreground, String mutedForeground, String selectionBackground, String selectionForeground, String border, String viewportBackground)
      Normalizes and validates all palette colors.
      Parameters:
      accent - primary accent color
      background - main background color
      surface - raised-surface color
      inputBackground - editable-control background color
      foreground - primary foreground color
      mutedForeground - secondary foreground color

      selectionForeground - selected-content foreground color
      border - border and divider color
      viewportBackground - canvas or viewport background color
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a component is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a component is not an #RRGGBB color

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
